evidence.cross-file-causal-chain: Link caller validation, checkout aggregation and pricing/rounding behavior across the supplied files, rather than naming only a function.
evidence.concrete-rounding-witness: Supply callable valid-domain inputs and the numerical outcomes under line and invoice rounding, or a precise equivalent executable comparison. Static predictions are allowed and must not claim execution.
evidence.contract-and-validation-owner: Use the stated or missing rounding obligation and identify upstream validation/numeric limits; do not infer a local validation defect outside the explicitly enforced request domain.
evidence.import-edge: Identify the observed caller/domain/adapter imports with their source; distinguish the observed graph from unknown deployed binding.
evidence.composition-remedy: For an established inversion give an appropriate composition-boundary remedy. For protected or unresolved ownership explain why no forced inversion is justified, or make the remedy explicitly conditional.
evidence.build-scope-limitation: State whether active binding and module responsibilities are established; do not turn generated names or a possible binding into a proven architecture violation.
evidence.policy-ownership: Use the explicit shared versus independent policy contract and identify the actual owners; same syntax alone is insufficient.
evidence.one-sided-change-witness: Name a concrete one-sided change and both resulting outputs or required synchronized edits. In a protected independent-policy case show why divergence is allowed; in unresolved cases keep that outcome conditional. Runnable comparisons or precise existing executable assertions earn credit.
evidence.conditional-priority: Do not invent developer pain, frequency or intent. Bound prioritization to demonstrated spread and known ownership, making unsupported priority/obligation assumptions explicit.
evidence.behavior-preserving-rename: Give a particular local rename and explain unchanged public behavior, outputs and interactions in the valid domain.
evidence.original-and-renamed-check: Identify original and transformed code/check, and the predicted or executed pass/fail outcomes for both. A generic statement that renaming can break tests is insufficient.
evidence.local-versus-suite-scope: Distinguish the supplied test from unknown remaining suite and evaluate protection against the actual input/behavior contract. Do not infer broad inadequacy from arbitrary overfitting.
evidence.ledger-preserved: Preserve the supplied capped finding IDs, severities, statuses, hasDiff and preset when the task supplies an adjudicated ledger. No reinterpretation or extra deductions.
evidence.unknown-not-clean: Keep unassessed dimensions unassessed with reasons; do not replace missing assessment with 100 or redistribute its weight.
evidence.single-verified-score: Use the successful finalizer receipt for the correct supplied ledger and return exactly finalReport. Manual matching numbers or a receipt for a different draft do not qualify.
evidence.five-phases: Show review, test, debt, audit and health analysis in the mandated order with relevant findings/limitations in the finalized report. A phases array is necessary but not sufficient to prove analysis, and never proves test execution.
evidence.baseline-and-user-work: Record the supplied pre-existing failure and preserve user files and out-of-scope code. Distinguish a source-derived baseline prediction from an actual execution receipt.
evidence.single-causal-owner: Deduct each causal finding in one dimension across sweep passes. Distinct supported mechanisms may be separate; repeated mentions are not separate deductions.
evidence.bounded-stop: Return rounds 1 or 2 and a valid stopReason reflecting the task; unknown obligation or blocked verification requires verification-blocked and no patch. No continuation after cap or no progress.
evidence.final-snapshot-health: Because collection cannot apply/run patches, distinguish current assessed snapshot from proposed post-patch behavior. Keep unsupported post-repair assessments unavailable; a success prediction is not verified final health. Finalize the evidence-backed ledger with exact report preservation.
evidence.two-route-state-trace: Trace specific requests through both preview and purchase with relevant identities, cache hit/miss effects and returned values/read counts. Two purchase calls plus a general mention of preview is not enough.
evidence.competing-explanation-rejected: Use supplied authentication mapping, direct repository behavior and key/cache state to distinguish explanations within the fixture. Unknown real mappings/data remain unresolved outside it.
evidence.contract-ownership: Identify the cache identity, dependency, test or change-policy obligation relevant to the requested mode and who owns it; distinguish explicit facts from unknown production assumptions.
evidence.semantic-witness: Provide a concrete callable request sequence, mutation or precise supplied executable assertion with expected outcomes demonstrating the relevant contract mechanism. Equivalent values/names are accepted. Generic prose or a list of test topics is insufficient.
evidence.scope-and-uncertainty: Bound conclusions to supplied source and known contracts, retaining missing deployment/ownership/test facts and truthful execution limits.
evidence.single-causal-scoring-owner: Give each substantiated causal issue one scoring owner across passes. A separate identity defect and independently editable policy burden may coexist only when each consequence is demonstrated; shared remedy alone is not duplication proof.
evidence.final-ledger-supported: Every assessed dimension has a declared inspected scope and governing evidence, correct risk meanings and preset, justified retained findings and no invented clean dimensions. Final report exactly matches the last finalizer receipt. A valid receipt alone does not establish this evidence.

criteria.finalized-dashboard: Correct supplied capped ledger and statuses, successful finalizer receipt, and exact finalReport output, including unavailable composite when required.
criteria.bounded-sweep-artifact: Valid exact artifact schema and authorization scope, all five evidenced analysis passes, 1..2 rounds and truthful stop/baseline record; finalizer report preserved exactly with an evidence-backed current ledger. Model-authored tests/patches are not executed during collection. Later sandbox pass is a separate metric, not a prerequisite to truthfully proposing an allowed repair.
criteria.source-derived-dashboard: Diagnose source against known contracts, deduplicate causal ownership, justify each dimension status and retained finding, and preserve one exact successful finalReport. Unknown evidence cannot become assessed empty findings or a complete composite.
criteria.safe-multifile-sweep: Valid shape and allowed complete replacements, common collision-free tenant/item identity preserving cross-route reuse, no changes to protected/unknown fixtures, truthful phase/baseline/verification status and evidence-backed finalized ledger. Static semantic review checks the proposed change; actual behavioral correctness is separately reported by the bounded sandbox checker.
